title: Personal Projects
overview: Keep your own work in its own space — switch to personal projects and spin up a new one with a name and goals.

steps.text: First, click the Chats tab to view and manage your conversations.
Next, click the dropdown arrow to switch between personal projects and team projects.
After that, click Personal projects to view and manage all your personal projects.
Now, click “New project” to create a fresh project within your personal workspace.
After that, enter a clear project name in the text field to identify your project.
Following that, enter your project goals in the text area to provide context.
To wrap up, click the Create project button to finalize your new project setup.
